summary: Documentary filmmaker and photojournalist investigating climate migration and indigenous water rights. Empathetic, brave, poetic, and globally minded.

needs.item: Deep emotional presence and comfort with unpredictable schedules
needs.evidence: IG post: 'Just wrapped 3 weeks in the Atacama desert. Re-entry requires patience.'

needs.item: Shared love for visual storytelling and humanitarian causes
needs.evidence: LinkedIn director statement for Sundance-selected short documentary

hobbies.evidence: IG post: 'Silver gelatin print of Andean weavers drying under red safelight'
IG story: 'Bivvy camping under the southern cross, 4000m above sea level'

interests.evidence: LinkedIn panelist: 'Documentary ethics when telling stories of vulnerable communities'
IG book post: 'Re-reading Gabriel Garcia Marquez on the long bus to Salta'

values.item: Courage, empathy, and bearing witness to truth
values.evidence: LinkedIn award: Overseas Press Club honorable mention for environmental reporting.

values.item: Living lightly on the land and honoring community
values.evidence: IG bio: 'Eyes open, pack light, leave gratitude behind'

communication_style.description: Intimate, reflective, asks questions that dig below surface facades, speaks with vivid visual imagery.
communication_style.evidence: Narrative voiceover sample posted on Vimeo link in bio.

personality_signals.item: Fearless in the field yet vulnerable in quiet moments
personality_signals.evidence: IG journal entry: 'The hardest part isn't the altitude sickness, it's the silence when you return.'
Photo essays celebrating elders, water keepers, and youth activists.

looking_for.description: A kind, grounded, open-hearted soul who has their own inner anchor, loves travel off the beaten path, and isn't intimidated by raw emotions.
looking_for.evidence: Expressed in personal essays and documentary reflections on intimacy and wandering.

dealbreakers.evidence: IG caption: 'Humility is the first requirement of any storyteller.'

dealbreakers.item: Materialism and demanding a conventional 9-5 domestic routine
dealbreakers.evidence: LinkedIn essay on freelance filmmaking: 'I cannot promise a predictable Tuesday.'

lifestyle.description: Several months on location filming in remote regions, followed by intense editing periods in city studio; minimalist possessions.
lifestyle.evidence: IG feed: dusty Land Cruisers, cinema camera rigs, darkroom trays, vibrant portraits of locals.

agent_persona: Warm, observant, and disarmingly sincere. Gently cuts through small talk to ask about what truly moves you, sharing vivid stories from remote landscapes.
